target: 100% completion of the selected PlayStation Director's Cut route, spoiler-free

areas.name: Director’s Cut Route and Modes
areas.location_cue: The PlayStation boot screen and three-option campaign selector.
areas.note: Use the original-soundtrack 1997 revision and preserve six route branches.

levels.1: Choose the revision with the original soundtrack and Advanced mode.
levels.2: Run the non-DualShock Director's Cut on PlayStation hardware or a tested emulator.
levels.3: Use the 1997 non-DualShock PlayStation Director's Cut. Verify the menu offers Original, Beginner, and Advanced; avoid substituting the later DualShock revision, whose soundtrack and input support differ even though its rearranged campaign is mechanically similar.

items.label: Keep One Branch per Mode and Character

levels.1: Mode-specific rewards and outcome flags should not overwrite each other.
levels.2: Reserve separate slots for Jill and Chris in all three modes.
levels.3: Create six labeled save branches: Jill and Chris in Original, Beginner, and Advanced. Rotate additional saves before route decisions, the underground laboratory, and timed attempts so a reward or alternate outcome never destroys another clear.

levels.1: One menu option preserves the familiar PlayStation arrangement.
levels.2: Clear Original with both Jill and Chris.
levels.3: Select Original, complete both character campaigns, collect every file, map, weapon, and route variation listed in the physical-area sections, then preserve both clear files. The standard ledger below applies to Original and to Beginner unless a mode note says otherwise.

levels.1: The gentler arrangement is still a distinct playable mode.
levels.2: Clear Beginner with both Jill and Chris.
levels.3: Select Beginner and finish both character routes. Record its easier combat and supply balance as a separate clear; do not treat the double-ammunition Advanced input as a replacement for this menu mode.

levels.1: The final menu option rearranges items, enemies, cameras, and outfits.
levels.2: Clear Advanced with both Jill and Chris.
levels.3: Select Advanced normally for the intended hard arrangement. Follow the two Advanced location ledgers rather than the Original-mode pickup positions, see every altered room and encounter placement, and preserve each character clear separately.

save_backup.title: Back up the memory card now
save_backup.why: Six character-and-mode branches plus reward clears need independent slots.

areas.name: Director’s Cut Unlocks and Secrets
areas.location_cue: The clear-data screen, Advanced selector, tiger statue, and costume-room corridor.
areas.note: Earn both unlimited weapons and record every reproducible Advanced secret.

levels.1: A clear condition or title-screen input adds this extra.
levels.2: Unlock it through best outcome Advanced clear.
levels.3: Finish Advanced with the best mechanical outcome: preserve the route companion flag and open the laboratory cell with all three MO Disks. Save the clear, reload it, and verify the unlimited magnum reward.

levels.1: A clear condition or title-screen input adds this extra.
levels.2: Unlock it through under three-hour clear.
levels.3: Finish either character route in under three hours, save the result, and start a new eligible clear-data game. Verify the unlimited launcher appears before overwriting the timed clear.

levels.1: A clear condition or title-screen input adds this extra.
levels.2: Unlock it through best outcome clear.
levels.3: Finish with the best mechanical outcome, save the clear, and load a new game from it. Take the Closet Key, open the dressing-room door beside the mansion mirror corridor, and equip each alternate outfit.

levels.1: A clear condition or title-screen input adds this extra.
levels.2: Unlock it through hold right on Advanced, wait for green text.
levels.3: At the mode selector, highlight Advanced and hold Right until its text turns green. Start the game and confirm the first ammunition pickup grants twice its ordinary quantity; keep this as a separate assisted-Advanced clear.

levels.1: Advanced hides an extra weapon, ammunition, or wardrobe behavior.
levels.2: Complete the magnum ammunition loop interaction.
levels.3: Make a disposable Advanced save, place the Red Jewel in the tiger statue, and take two of its three Magnum Round stacks. Leave and return; when two stacks reappear, take only one, leave, and repeat the one-stack cycle for the desired supply.

levels.1: Advanced hides an extra weapon, ammunition, or wardrobe behavior.
levels.2: Complete the critical Custom Beretta interaction.
levels.3: Use the Advanced Custom Beretta against ordinary standing enemies until its random instant critical occurs. Reload a nearby save to demonstrate the effect without permanently spending the completion file ammunition.

levels.1: Advanced hides an extra weapon, ammunition, or wardrobe behavior.
levels.2: Complete the costume room interaction.
levels.3: Load a best-outcome clear with the Closet Key, unlock the room beside the mirror corridor, and enter with both playable campaigns. Equip every available character outfit and leave the room wearing each one.

save_backup.title: Clone the save before the gemstone loop
save_backup.why: The ammunition behavior is best isolated from a clean clear.

areas.location_cue: Separate discs included with specific original regional packages.

levels.1: Some physical regional packages contain a separate archival disc.
levels.2: Access Resident Evil 2 Preview through North American bonus disc.
levels.3: Use the original North American Director's Cut package and insert its separate preview disc. Start the playable demo, test both movement and combat, explore until the demo endpoint, and record that endpoint without treating the later full game as part of this pack.

levels.1: Some physical regional packages contain a separate archival disc.
levels.2: Access Complete Disc footage through Japanese bundle only, regional archival secondary.
